text:
Hi Rafael Dubois and Eva Romano, thanks for reaching out to the Companion Animal Travel Desk. We’re really sorry to hear your journey didn’t go as smoothly as it should have, and that Finn was affected by the stress of the situation. You’re letting us know that a delay disrupted your travel plan and you felt you missed a critical moment to connect with us afterward.

We hear you, and we want to help you get this sorted in a way that feels fair and clear. At Aurelia Skyways, we treat pet travel as a shared responsibility, and when departures don’t go according to plan, we ask our cabin and ground teams to keep the pet care needs in view while coordinating updates as calmly as possible.

For the issue you raised, <<FACT F109>> so you can plan around what to expect from a standard payout tied to this kind of incident. In parallel, if the concern also involves a missed opportunity to file the claim in time, <<FACT F116>>. We understand that travel disruptions can make timelines feel messy, and we’ll do what we can to make the process straightforward.

To move things along, the best next step is to share the details you already have from your booking and the day of travel: the route, the booking reference, and any written confirmation you received about the delayed departure. If there are messages, gate announcements, or notes from crew that explain what changed and when, include those too. Our team will review the situation in a calm, stepwise way, and if any missing information is needed, we will contact you with specific guidance rather than leaving you to guess.

We also want to acknowledge that your experience matters. Even when delays happen for reasons outside anyone’s control, how we communicate and how we handle companion animals is something we take seriously. That’s why our department shares practical instructions with crews so that pets like Finn are not treated like an afterthought when plans shift.

If you reply with the requested trip details, the Companion Animal Travel Desk will escalate the case for review and provide an update as soon as we can. We appreciate your patience and the care you showed in looking out for Finn, and we’ll work to get you a resolution.  

Companion Animal Travel Desk
